A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the LTP probe is able to generate a highly efficient and spatially localized afterglow region with a high density of reagent ions, which are produced by charge-transfer reactions with atmospheric nitrogen.

the LTP is not a cold plasma, as previously assumed.
